content: Official Theia guidance: for a new project, start with generator-theia-extension (Yeoman) for a minimal scaffold to learn the extension model quickly; graduate to cloning theia-ide (ex-theia-blueprint) as the product template once you need a real installable product (installers, auto-update, full branding). You can migrate extensions written against the Yeoman scaffold into the theia-ide template later without losing work.
